name: invoicing-001-baseline
statements: CREATE TABLE document_series(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,document_type TEXT NOT NULL,series TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,document_type,series),CONSTRAINT document_series_document_type_valid CHECK(document_type IN('invoice','proforma')),CONSTRAINT document_series_series_shape CHECK(length(series)BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND series ~ '^[A-Z0-9]' AND series !~ '[^A-Z0-9_-]'))

CREATE TABLE invoice_sequences(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,fiscal_year INTEGER NOT NULL,document_type TEXT NOT NULL,series TEXT NOT NULL,last_number INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT invoice_sequences_last_number_positive CHECK(last_number>0),PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,fiscal_year,document_type,series))

CREATE TABLE audit_events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT audit_events_actor_id_length CHECK(length(actor_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT audit_events_action_length CHECK(length(action) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),target_kind TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT audit_events_target_kind_length CHECK(length(target_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),target_id TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT audit_events_target_id_length CHECK(length(target_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),reason TEXT CONSTRAINT audit_events_reason_length CHECK(reason IS NULL OR length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 500))

CREATE TABLE idempotency_records(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT idempotency_records_key_length CHECK(length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),operation TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT idempotency_records_operation_valid CHECK(operation IN('create_draft','issue_invoice_direct','issue_invoice_from_draft','issue_proforma_direct','issue_proforma_from_draft','issue_invoice_from_proforma','create_draft_invoice_from_proforma','create_correction')),fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT idempotency_records_fingerprint_shape CHECK(length(fingerprint)=71 AND substr(fingerprint,1,7)='sha256:' AND substr(fingerprint,8) !~ '[^0-9a-f]'),result_kind TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT idempotency_records_result_kind_valid CHECK(result_kind IN('invoice','proforma','draft','correction')),result_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,idempotency_key),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id)REFERENCES issuers(organization_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT)

CREATE TABLE invoice_drafts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,customer_id TEXT,customer_party_type TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT invoice_drafts_customer_party_type_valid CHECK(customer_party_type IN('company','individual')),customer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,customer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,customer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,customer_city TEXT NOT NULL,customer_street TEXT NOT NULL,customer_county TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT invoice_drafts_customer_county_valid CHECK(customer_county IN('RO-AB','RO-AR','RO-AG','RO-BC','RO-BH','RO-BN','RO-BR','RO-BT','RO-BV','RO-B','RO-BZ','RO-CS','RO-CL','RO-CJ','RO-CT','RO-CV','RO-DB','RO-DJ','RO-GL','RO-GR','RO-GJ','RO-HR','RO-HD','RO-IL','RO-IS','RO-IF','RO-MM','RO-MH','RO-MS','RO-NT','RO-OT','RO-PH','RO-SM','RO-SJ','RO-SB','RO-SV','RO-TR','RO-TM','RO-TL','RO-VS','RO-VL','RO-VN')),customer_sector INTEGER,customer_postal_code TEXT,customer_vat_registered INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT invoice_drafts_customer_vat_registered_valid CHECK(customer_vat_registered IN(0,1)AND(customer_party_type!='individual' OR customer_vat_registered=0)),series TEXT NOT NULL,issue_date TEXT NOT NULL,due_date TEXT,currency TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT invoice_drafts_currency_ron CHECK(currency='RON'),status TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT invoice_drafts_status_valid CHECK(status IN('draft','issued','proforma_issued')),source_app TEXT,source_kind TEXT,source_id TEXT,notes TEXT CONSTRAINT invoice_drafts_notes_shape CHECK(notes IS NULL OR(length(notes) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND trim(notes)=notes)),UNIQUE(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,customer_id)REFERENCES customers(organization_id,id),CONSTRAINT invoice_drafts_bucharest_sector CHECK((customer_county='RO-B' AND customer_sector BETWEEN 1 AND 6)OR(customer_county!='RO-B' AND customer_sector IS NULL)))

proformas_document_type_proforma CHECK(document_type='proforma'),series TEXT NOT NULL,number INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT proformas_number_positive CHECK(number>0),issue_date TEXT NOT NULL,due_date proformas_customer_county_valid CHECK(customer_county INTEGER,customer_postal_code TEXT,customer_vat_registered INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT proformas_customer_vat_registered_valid CHECK(customer_vat_registered IN(0,1)AND(customer_party_type!='individual' OR customer_vat_registered=0)),total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_total TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CONSTRAINT proformas_sealed_flag CHECK(sealed IN(0,1)),source_app TEXT,source_kind TEXT,source_id TEXT,notes TEXT CONSTRAINT proformas_notes_shape CHECK(notes IS NULL OR(length(notes) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND trim(notes)=notes)),issuer_branding TEXT CONSTRAINT proformas_issuer_branding_json CHECK(issuer_branding IS NULL OR issuer_branding IS JSON),issuer_legal_form TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT proformas_issuer_legal_form_valid CHECK(issuer_legal_form IN('srl','pfa')),issuer_trade_registry_number TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_iban TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_bank_name TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_social_capital proformas_issuer_vat_registered_flag CHECK(issuer_vat_registered IN(0,1)),UNIQUE(organization_id,id),UNIQUE(organization_id,fiscal_year,series,number),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,source_draft_id)REFERENCES invoice_drafts(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,document_type,series)REFERENCES issuer_sector IS NULL)),CONSTRAINT proformas_customer_bucharest_sector CHECK((customer_county='RO-B' AND customer_sector BETWEEN 1 AND 6)OR(customer_county!='RO-B' AND customer_sector IS NULL)))

CREATE TABLE proforma_conversions(proforma_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,resulting_draft_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,converted_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,resulting_draft_id)REFERENCES invoice_drafts(organization_id,id))

CREATE TABLE proforma_invoice_conversions(proforma_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,resulting_invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,converted_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,resulting_invoice_id)REFERENCES issued_invoices(organization_id,id))

CREATE TABLE draft_lines(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,draft_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL,unit_price TEXT NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,tax_category TEXT NOT NULL,tax_rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT draft_lines_unit_code_length CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3),unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT draft_lines_unit_name_length CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),UNIQUE(draft_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(draft_id)REFERENCES invoice_drafts(id)ON DELETE CASCADE,CONSTRAINT draft_lines_tax_matrix CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND tax_rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND tax_rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND tax_rate='5.00' AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND tax_rate='0.00' AND tax_category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))

CREATE TABLE issued_lines(id TEXT NOT NULL,invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL,unit_price TEXT NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,tax_category TEXT NOT NULL,tax_rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT issued_lines_unit_code_length CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3),unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT issued_lines_unit_name_length CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),PRIMARY KEY(invoice_id,id),UNIQUE(invoice_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(invoice_id)REFERENCES issued_invoices(id),CONSTRAINT issued_lines_tax_matrix CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND tax_rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND tax_rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND tax_rate='5.00' AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND tax_rate='0.00' AND tax_category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))

CREATE TABLE issued_tax_breakdown(invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,category TEXT NOT NULL,rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,taxable_amount TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(invoice_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(invoice_id)REFERENCES issued_invoices(id),CONSTRAINT issued_tax_breakdown_tax_matrix CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND rate='5.00' AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND rate='0.00' AND category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))

CREATE TABLE proforma_lines(id TEXT NOT NULL,proforma_id TEXT NOT NULL,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL,unit_price TEXT NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,tax_category TEXT NOT NULL,tax_rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT proforma_lines_unit_code_length CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3),unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT proforma_lines_unit_name_length CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),PRIMARY KEY(proforma_id,id),UNIQUE(proforma_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),CONSTRAINT proforma_lines_tax_matrix CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND tax_rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND tax_rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND tax_rate='5.00' AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND tax_rate='0.00' AND tax_category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))

CREATE TABLE proforma_tax_breakdown(proforma_id TEXT NOT NULL,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,category TEXT NOT NULL,rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,taxable_amount TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(proforma_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),CONSTRAINT proforma_tax_breakdown_tax_matrix CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND rate='5.00' AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND rate='0.00' AND category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))

CREATE TABLE correction_lines(id TEXT NOT NULL,correction_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL,unit_price TEXT NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,tax_category TEXT NOT NULL,tax_rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT correction_lines_unit_code_length CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3),unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT correction_lines_unit_name_length CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),PRIMARY KEY(correction_id,id),UNIQUE(correction_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(correction_id)REFERENCES correction_documents(id),CONSTRAINT correction_lines_tax_matrix CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND tax_rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND tax_rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND tax_rate='5.00' AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND tax_rate='0.00' AND tax_category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))

CREATE TABLE correction_tax_breakdown(correction_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,category TEXT NOT NULL,rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,taxable_amount TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(correction_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(correction_id)REFERENCES correction_documents(id),CONSTRAINT correction_tax_breakdown_tax_matrix CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND rate='5.00' AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND rate='0.00' AND category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))

CREATE FUNCTION qwbe_proforma_conversions_require_lineage() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $qwbe$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proformas p WHERE p.id=NEW.proforma_id AND p.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND p.sealed=1)OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoice_drafts d WHERE d.id=NEW.resulting_draft_id AND d.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND d.status='draft')OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_invoice_conversions i WHERE i.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND i.proforma_id=NEW.proforma_id)OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issued_invoices i WHERE i.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND i.source_proforma_id=NEW.proforma_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='invalid proforma draft conversion lineage'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $qwbe$

CREATE FUNCTION qwbe_proforma_invoice_conversions_match() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $qwbe$ BEGIN IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_conversions c WHERE c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.proforma_id=NEW.proforma_id)OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issued_invoices i WHERE i.id=NEW.resulting_invoice_id AND i.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND i.draft_id IS NULL AND i.source_proforma_id=NEW.proforma_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='proforma invoice conversion does not match'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $qwbe$

CREATE FUNCTION qwbe_invoice_drafts_series_insert() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $qwbe$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_series WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND document_type='invoice' AND series=NEW.series) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='invoice document series is not configured'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $qwbe$

CREATE FUNCTION qwbe_issued_invoices_lineage_insert() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $qwbe$ BEGIN IF (NEW.draft_id IS NULL AND NEW.source_proforma_id IS NOT NULL AND(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_conversions c WHERE c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.proforma_id=NEW.source_proforma_id)OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proformas p WHERE p.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND p.id=NEW.source_proforma_id AND p.sealed=1)))OR(NEW.draft_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_proforma_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_conversions c WHERE c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.resulting_draft_id=NEW.draft_id))OR(NEW.draft_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_proforma_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_conversions c WHERE c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.proforma_id=NEW.source_proforma_id AND c.resulting_draft_id=NEW.draft_id)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='invalid invoice proforma lineage'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $qwbe$

CREATE FUNCTION qwbe_proforma_lines_no_late_insert() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $qwbe$ BEGIN IF (SELECT sealed FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id)!=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='proforma lines are sealed'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $qwbe$

CREATE FUNCTION qwbe_proforma_tax_no_late_insert() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $qwbe$ BEGIN IF (SELECT sealed FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id)!=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='proforma tax breakdown is sealed'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $qwbe$
